description: PRD-129: Workspace Outputs Hub — transform the VS Code-style Workspace tab into a consumer-friendly Gallery of agent deliverables (reports, images, documents, code, slides). New deliverables table, DeliverableService, /api/deliverables endpoints, Gallery/Explorer/Activity view toggle, filter bar, card grid, preview slide-over. Auto-register deliverables when agents write files or submit reports.

userStories.title: Create deliverables table migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a deliverables table to store metadata about all agent outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create alembic migration file orchestrator/alembic/versions/prd129_deliverables.py with down_revision set to the current alembic head (check with `alembic heads` — do NOT hardcode prd128_notifications since it may not exist)

Table deliverables has columns: id UUID PK (gen_random_uuid default), workspace_id UUID NOT NULL FK workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, source_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, source_id VARCHAR(255) NULL, agent_id INTEGER NULL FK agents(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, agent_name VARCHAR(100) NULL, artifact_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, summary VARCHAR(500) NULL, storage_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'workspace', file_path VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, file_name VARCHAR(255) NULL, file_type VARCHAR(50) NULL, file_size_bytes BIGINT NULL, preview_url VARCHAR(1024) NULL, preview_type VARCHAR(30) NULL, extra JSONB DEFAULT '{}', status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'ready', deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
Column is named `extra` not `metadata` to avoid conflict with SQLAlchemy Base.metadata
file_size_bytes is BIGINT (not INTEGER) to support files >2GB
Includes deleted_at column (soft delete)

Create indices: ix_deliverables_workspace(workspace_id), ix_deliverables_agent(agent_id), ix_deliverables_type(workspace_id, artifact_type), ix_deliverables_source(workspace_id, source_type), ix_deliverables_created(workspace_id, created_at DESC)
Create UNIQUE constraint uq_deliverables_workspace_path ON (workspace_id, file_path) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL — for idempotent re-registration
upgrade() and downgrade() functions both implemented
Run migration successfully: `cd orchestrator && alembic upgrade head`
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement DeliverableService with register/list/get/stats
userStories.description: As a backend developer, I need a service that owns all deliverable CRUD and handles idempotent registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/services/deliverable_service.py
Module-level EXTENSION_TO_ARTIFACT dict maps extensions to artifact types per PRD-129 §2 (images, reports, documents, slides, spreadsheets, code, archives, audio, video)
Module-level helpers: _slugify(value), _infer_artifact_type(file_path)
Class DeliverableService(db: Session, workspace_id: UUID)

register() method: ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, file_path) DO UPDATE — idempotent. Accepts file_path, title, source_type, source_id, agent_id, agent_name, artifact_type, summary, storage_type, extra. Infers artifact_type if None. Does NOT call WorkspaceClient during register — file_size_bytes accepted as optional kwarg so callers that already have the size can pass it in (no hot-path HTTP)

list_deliverables() method: filters by artifact_type, source_type, agent_id, date_from, date_to, search; supports limit/offset; excludes deleted_at IS NOT NULL; returns { success, deliverables, total, limit, offset }; LEFT JOIN agents to get current agent name fallback

get_deliverable(deliverable_id, include_content=False) method: returns single row; when include_content=True and storage_type=workspace and artifact_type != image, reads file via WorkspaceClient; for images returns content_url
get_stats() method: returns { success, total, by_type, by_agent }
soft_delete(deliverable_id) method: sets deleted_at = NOW()
All SQL uses sqlalchemy text() with bound params (no string interpolation of user input)
All methods return dict envelopes with success key
Exceptions logged with exc_info=True
Write unit tests in orchestrator/tests/services/test_deliverable_service.py covering register (new + idempotent update), list with filters, get_deliverable, soft_delete
Tests pass: `cd orchestrator && python -m pytest tests/services/test_deliverable_service.py -v`
Typecheck passes

Workspace ID validated via existing _user_has_workspace_access pattern (no trusting header without check)
